purpose: Descriptive regroup, not a new trading strategy or a parameter search
sampling: First end-of-minute occurrence per baseline episode and threshold with surviving depth >=9 and gross inventory PnL <= threshold. Apply only archived inventory events with fillIndex <= this candle index before observing the close. A resting TP already filled in this minute leaves no position to label. Do not count repeated underwater minutes as independent observations.
comparisons: All four accepted unchanged baselines. Report full completed-episode wins/losses and winning/losing dollars beside the selected descriptive cohort; unresolved final episodes stay separate. Threshold cohorts overlap and are not prospective rule returns.
accountingClarification: Report already-incurred marked episode losses at first observation and subsequent episode-value change separately, including prior partials and the archived closing-fee reserve. Added after the initial descriptive output to prevent treating total losing-episode dollars as avoidable loss. This does not change cohort selection or trade paths and is not a same-close liquidation backtest.
timing: Historical prices must reproduce each original captured byte-prefix hash, then use the original verified repair overlay. Outcomes after an observation are labels only, never entry inputs. Latest live decision echoes are primary; a preceding S/R shadow is labeled as a nearby observation, not exact decision parity.
limitations: No new economic replay, exchange query, tuning, causal benefit claim, promotion screen or deployment. Historical cohorts are previously mined modeled paths, not live odds. Existing maker/funding/arrival/liquidation limitations remain. The latest open live episode is unfinished, not a realized losing episode.
